svg.title: Turtle GPS tracks in the Chagos Archipelago
svg.desc: Eight actual sampled turtle tracks extracted from the Marine Migration Visualizer Folium map. Geographic longitude and latitude grid; no synthetic tracks or basemap.

g.text: 8 sampled turtle GPS tracks · Chagos Archipelago
Source dataset: 88,727 valid, visible observations · 23 turtles
Hawksbill & green turtles · Static view of recorded movements
